Rewrite the three equations with everything on one side:

- $x - y - z = 2$
- $-x + y - z = 1$
- $-x - y + z = 4$

Adding all three gives $-(x+y+z) = 7$, so $x+y+z = -7$.

Check: adding the first two gives $-2z = 3$, so $z = -\tfrac32$. Then $x - y = 2 + z = \tfrac12$ and $x + y = z - 4 = -\tfrac{11}{2}$, so $x = -\tfrac52$ and $y = -3$. Then $x+y+z = -\tfrac52 - 3 - \tfrac32 = -7$, and all three original equations hold.

ANSWER: -7
